summary: The relay was healthy but had zero editor windows. The editor tab was already loaded (MAIN, b275cd23...), but the automatic landing popup was blocked. Opening the relay /landing page in the same browser, selecting it, and clicking its #pop button with a real user gesture opened the EasyEDA landing page; within about 1 s /health flipped to edaConnected:true, edaWindowCount:1, activeWindowId 25883914a72e5cbb. t53 then passed 5/5 at exit 0 with 21 components, 8 parts, 13 netflags, 55 wires, 55 pairs, 2 pages. Live query confirmed +3V3 is componentType=part and the page list is exactly MAIN + P1.

registration.trigger: real click on #pop in http://127.0.0.1:49620/landing, in the same browser as the loaded editor tab

sourceProtocol.answer: Not an HTTP /register and not a postMessage callback in this repo. The local relay /landing page opens EasyEDA's own https://pro.lceda.cn/api/landing?port=... popup; that external page performs the BroadcastChannel post. The editor's built-in run-api-gateway then dials the fixed ws://127.0.0.1:49630, receives the relay handshake, and sends a WebSocket {type:'register', windowId|tabId}; the relay adds it to edaClients. The extension path is eda.sys_WebSocket.register().

externalLandingScript.evidence: packages/eda-core/bin/dsh-eda-bridge.mjs:196-200 comment: opens the EasyEDA landing page as a script-opened popup so its own window.close() succeeds after the BroadcastChannel post; bridge.ts:39-44 calls it the landing URL that wakes the built-in run-api-gateway; bridge.ts:47 requires the same browser and an editor tab that has finished loading.
externalLandingScript.limitation: The external pro.lceda.cn page is third-party and not in this repo, so its exact JavaScript cannot be quoted line-by-line; the local relay and bridge semantics are quoted below, and the observed registration confirms the path.

triggerConditions: Relay must be listening on 49620 (HTTP/health) and 49630 (the fixed endpoint the editor's built-in gateway dials).
The EasyEDA editor tab must already be loaded in the same browser; a different browser is explicitly documented as leaving the relay with no window.
The external landing page must be opened as a popup/tab in that same browser and same pro.lceda.cn origin so its BroadcastChannel reaches the editor's built-in gateway.
window.open needs a user gesture. The relay page calls pop() automatically, but browsers block it; #manual becomes visible and the #pop button is the required real-click path. I used that path.

The project should be loaded for execute/pages: bridge.ts:47 says execute works only once attached to the window whose schematic page list is non-empty. Here MAIN was loaded and the live page list was non-empty.
sourceProtocol.noRegisterEndpoint: http-api.mjs has only GET /health, GET /eda-windows, POST /eda-windows/select, POST /execute; no /register.
